mapper.sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.user_id, s.student_no, s.birth_date, s.school_name, s.grade_level, s.memo, s.created_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.status_code FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id

where.if: AND (u.name ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR u.login_id ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR s.student_no ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (user_id, student_no, birth_date, school_name, grade_level) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{birthDate}, #{schoolName}, #{gradeLevel})
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.student_id DESC LIMIT #{cond.size} OFFSET #{cond.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id

SELECT sp.student_parent_id, sp.parent_id, sp.relation_code, sp.primary_yn, u.login_id, u.name, u.phone FROM student_parents sp JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = sp.parent_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE sp.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sp.primary_yn DESC, sp.student_parent_id

SELECT e.enrollment_id, e.class_id, e.enroll_date, e.end_date, e.status_code, c.class_name, c.subject FROM enrollments e JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY e.status_code, e.enroll_date DESC
